mapper.select: SELECT pp.id, pp.account_id, a.account_type, a.organization_type, pp.registered, pp.status, pp.last_heartbeat_event_id, pp.last_heartbeat_at, pp.last_sync_at, pp.heartbeat_sequence, pp.version FROM police_phone pp JOIN account a ON a.id = pp.account_id WHERE pp.id = #{policePhoneId,typeHandler=com.surimap.config.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler} AND pp.status = 'ACTIVE' AND a.status = 'ACTIVE'
SELECT display_name FROM police_phone WHERE id = #{policePhoneId,typeHandler=com.surimap.config.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler} AND status = 'ACTIVE'

SELECT ia.incident_id FROM police_phone pp JOIN incident_assignment ia ON CAST(ia.account_id AS VARCHAR) = CAST(pp.account_id AS VARCHAR) AND ia.revoked_at IS NULL WHERE pp.id = #{policePhoneId,typeHandler=com.surimap.config.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler} AND pp.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY ia.assigned_at DESC, ia.id ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT pp.id AS police_phone_id, pp.account_id, a.account_type, a.organization_type, ia.incident_id, pp.last_heartbeat_event_id, pp.last_heartbeat_at, pp.last_sync_at, pp.version, pp.heartbeat_sequence FROM incident_assignment ia JOIN police_phone pp ON CAST(pp.account_id AS VARCHAR) = CAST(ia.account_id AS VARCHAR) AND pp.status = 'ACTIVE' AND pp.registered = TRUE JOIN account a ON a.id = pp.account_id AND a.status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE ia.incident_id = #{incidentId,typeHandler=com.surimap.config.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler} AND ia.revoked_at IS NULL ORDER BY pp.id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fcm_token ( id, account_id, police_phone_id, app_instance_id, token_hash, token_ciphertext, status, created_at, last_registered_at, version ) VALUES ( #{id,typeHandler=com.surimap.config.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}, #{accountId,typeHandler=com.surimap.config.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}, #{policePhoneId,typeHandler=com.surimap.config.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}, #{appInstanceId}, #{tokenHash}, #{tokenCiphertext}, #{status}, #{registeredAt}, #{registeredAt}, #{version} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, police_phone_id, app_instance_id, token_ciphertext, token_hash, status, version FROM fcm_token WHERE police_phone_id = #{policePhoneId,typeHandler=com.surimap.config.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler} AND status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY app_instance_id ASC, id ASC
